purpose: MLflow Tracking, Registry and UI; app-owned packaging, GitOps-owned production workload.
boundaries: Separate image/runtime from training and inference. No new application deployment or database is introduced by moving source.
No MLflow fork or custom React UI. Production config, IAM, migrations and enablement stay in GitOps/infrastructure.
Unconfigured base/server-version/compatibility pins block publication. Local Compose uses PostgreSQL and filesystem artifacts, not production S3.
